CA.rationale: No explicit attention/allocation relation linking to identified content found.

COD.rationale: Content (coordinate set) and its presentation (coordinate listing) plus a separate origin/status field are all explicitly present for the same referent/time.

A.rationale: No explicit attention/allocation or processing condition tied to the same content's presentation/access was stated.

C.rationale: The report names explicit content coordinate sets and attributes (e.g. red/blue) for identified referents.

D.rationale: An explicit origin/status field is provided separately from the content coordinate listing, distinguishing identification from status/organization.

O.rationale: Coordinate listings and an explicit grid-orientation statement describe how content is presented/organized.
